---
name: face-atlas-2d
description: The 2D sprite-face system (expression and viseme atlases projected on cylinder heads, SAPI/Rhubarb lip-sync). Use when adding expressions, mouth shapes, face details or changing lip-sync.
---
# 2D Face Atlas (no 3D mouth deformation, ever)

**Heads.** A head is a smooth cylinder (`minifig_builder.mesh_head`). UV u spans the front 150° and v spans the head height.
Outside 0..1 the overlay is masked, so the back of the head is plain plastic.

**Atlases** are generated by `vault_config/face_atlases/generate_atlases.py`, a 4×4 grid of 512 px cells drawn 3× supersampled with thick ink.
Indices live in `face_atlas_spec.json`:
- `eyes`: innocent_dot, deadpan_tired, shocked_wide, smug_smirk, sweating_nervous, angry_brow, blink, happy_closed, side_glance
- `mouths`: Rhubarb/Preston-Blair X A B C D E F G H, plus expression mouths smirk, frown, wavy, shock_O, grin
- `expression_rest_mouth`: the mouth to use when an actor is silent
- Per-character detail layers (blush, freckles, beard, wrinkles, lashes) sit under the eyes and mouth.

**Shader** (`look_dev.face_material`). An Attribute node of type OBJECT reads `face_expr` / `face_mouth` from the head object's custom properties.
It computes the cell column/row, offsets the UV, then layers skin → detail → eyes → mouth. Keyframing those props with CONSTANT interpolation
gives frame-exact switches.

**Lip-sync** (`engine/lipsync_2d.py`):
1. SAPI viseme events (captured during TTS, calibrated to the measured speech span because SAPI's AudioPosition drifts about 1.4×) are mapped to shapes.
2. Each 12 fps frame takes the shape with the largest overlap. Closed-lip A (M/B/P) gets a 1.6× priority so plosives survive.
3. Single-frame rests between speech frames are filled in.

Optional: `--rhubarb` uses Rhubarb Lip Sync on any recorded WAV (`python bootstrap_studio.py --with-rhubarb`).

**Blinks** are automatic (every 2.2–4.2 s, one frame), except on happy_closed, blink and shocked_wide.

To add an expression: write a draw function, append its name to `eyes` in the spec plus its rest mouth, re-run the generator, and add it to the catalog.
